title: AgentAdmissionManifest
description: Registry admission entry that makes a capability-bearing agent's authority visible. Realizes INV-ACC-1 (no invisible authority) from socioprophet-agent-standards Standard 030: an agent that declares capabilities MUST have a resolvable admission entry. A `proposed` manifest makes the agent visible and tracked but grants NO authority until a human owner signs off (admission_status=admitted, authority.granted=true). This record does not grant live credentials or runtime authority by itself.

agent_id.description: Identity of the agent being admitted, matching the declared-capability record's agent_id.

source.description: Where the agent's capability was declared in the estate (from ds.agents-manifests).

declared_capabilities.description: The capabilities/tools/verbs the agent claims. Non-empty: an admission entry only exists because the agent bears capability.

admission_status.description: proposed = visible/tracked but NOT authorized; admitted = owner-signed-off and authorized; denied/revoked = fail-closed.

production_admitted.description: Must be false unless admission_status is admitted and authority.granted is true.

risk_class.description: Triage class. destructive-offensive covers kill.agent/policy.evaluate/quorum.vote/exec.command and cloud enum/exploit surfaces.

granted.description: True only after a human owner authorizes. Proposed stubs are always false.

authority_refs.description: Owner/grant/policy/control/evidence refs that warrant the capability. Left EMPTY in a proposed stub; the owner fills these on sign-off. This is the gap INV-ACC-1 closes.

owner_repo.description: Repo whose owner must sign off.

approval_required_from.description: Who must approve before authority.granted may become true.

sign_off.description: Null until signed. On sign-off carries approver identity, decision, and evidence ref.

invariant.description: No invisible authority: capability without a resolvable admission entry is denied.

allOf.description: A proposed/denied/revoked manifest must not claim granted authority or production admission.
